about_short_description.short_description: AutoHub is a B2B marketplace for auto dealerships.

product.name: Dynamic Banner
product.description: A customizable call-to-action banner installed on search and vehicle detail pages to attract customers to the trade-in widget and display promotional trade-in bonuses.

product.name: Short Code
product.description: A text-based lead generation tool allowing customers to text a short code with a keyword to receive a personalized trade-in offer link, verifying mobile numbers for lead quality.

product.name: Direct Link
product.description: A URL that opens the trade-in interface over the dealership homepage, encouraging customers to explore vehicle specials after obtaining their trade-in estimate.

product.name: Customer Vehicle Rating System
product.description: A system where customers rate their vehicle’s cosmetic, mechanical, and safety conditions to involve them in appraisal and help manage offer expectations.

product.name: Vehicle Eligibility Check
product.description: A configurable system that restricts automated trade-in offers for vehicles based on criteria like history, value, age, mileage, and customer ratings.
